label.purpose: Navigation, roles, nodes, and board headers.

components.name: Primary Install Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #071824; background: #ef5b18; border: 1px solid #9b3408; border-radius: 0; font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 850; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #ff6f2c; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef5b18; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A flat paper action for source and documentation links.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #071824; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #071824; border-radius: 0; font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color: #0f5b9a; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef5b18; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Control Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase links on the bright control-paper header.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; background: #f8faf8; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #071824; font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #0f5b9a; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef5b18; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Planning Route Strip
components.description: A mechanical ownership record with role, name, responsibility, and dependency.
components.css: .ds-route-strip { min-height: 43px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 120px minmax(180px, 1fr) 120px; align-items: center; color: #071824; background: #bed6ea; border: 1px solid #071824; border-radius: 0; } .ds-route-strip > * { padding: 7px 9px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(7,24,36,.32); } .ds-route-strip > *:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-route-strip strong, .ds-route-strip span:first-child { font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Accepted Goal Strip
components.description: The terminal proof signal after root acceptance.
components.css: .ds-goal-strip { padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; color: #1a653b; background: #cce6c9; border: 1px solid #071824; border-radius: 0; } .ds-goal-strip span { font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Install Command Panel
components.description: A bounded copyable command surface without decorative chrome.
components.css: .ds-command { padding: 12px 14px 13px; color: #071824; background: #e2ebeb; border: 1px solid #a3b3b8; border-radius: 0; } .ds-command strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: #415764; font-family: "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-command code { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: .76rem/1.55 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: CodeCanopy is an engineering operations surface: pale control paper, navy mechanical rules, nested flight strips, and a single safety-orange action signal. The system is dense but calm, making ownership, dependencies, and acceptance physically legible without generic AI imagery or decorative effects.
keyCharacteristics: Split factual copy and nested route rack at desktop width.
Flat, square, rule-bound surfaces with no ornamental depth.
Blue means planned work, green means accepted evidence, and orange means action.
Condensed labels organize the board; neutral body text carries explanations.

rules.name: The Control-Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is reserved for an action a visitor can take; it is never decoration or a work state.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay physically flat; hierarchy is structural, never simulated with glow, glass, or shadow.

dos: Do make ownership and artifact dependencies visible before adding decoration.
Do keep action orange rare and preserve WCAG AA contrast in default, hover, and focus states.
Do collapse narrow layouts to one readable route while retaining a root-to-goal proof.
Do use green only for accepted evidence or the verified goal.
donts: Don't add gradients, purple, glow, glass, shadows, rounded SaaS cards, or generic AI network imagery.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as interface icons.
Don't invent runtime states, timestamps, checks, adoption metrics, or provider support.
Don't place detached eyebrow copy above the primary headline.
